ns2:course.label: History of Southern Africa
ns2:course.description: Survey of major themes and events in Southern African history, with emphasis on the period after World War II: the inception and development of apartheid in South Africa, the growth of contests over African nationalism in the subcontinent, wars of liberation and the demise of white domination. Prerequisite: HIST 110 or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.sectionDegreeAttributes: Hist&Philosoph Perspect, and Non-Western Cultures course.
